body.name: Proposed compatible-prefix approximation program
body.construction: The handle \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{tree}}\) denotes the following proposed, not yet certified approximation program for \(G_{T,c}(P)\): partition unconditional subtree-root masses into dyadic occupancy ranges; approximate rational descendant contributions jointly in unconditional child masses subject to every parent-sum identity; lift the resulting mixed monomials by multinomial factorial moments or degenerate \(U\)-statistics while retaining covariance between nested prefixes; and seek dual moment-matched priors whose draws are whole legal subtrees.  No polynomial degree, coefficient array, variance certificate, or legal prior pair is asserted by this definition.
